  "summary": "The Swatantra Party Constitution, as amended on 14 April 1973 at the Sixth National Convention in Rajajinagar, Madras, establishes the Party’s name, objective, headquarters, membership rules, subscription arrangements, and internal organisational structure. It defines a layered system of Primary Units, District Committees, State or Regional Councils, a General Council, and a National Executive. Membership is open to persons over 18 who subscribe to the Party’s principles, pay the prescribed fee, and are willing to work for the Party; the text also provides procedures for suspension, expulsion, appeals, subscriptions, accounting, and participation in Party activities.\n\nThe later provisions regulate representation, office-bearing, quorum, absence from meetings, elections, election tribunals, co-options, conventions, rule-making, and constitutional amendment. The accompanying Appendix A specifies voting procedures at all levels, including secret ballots, scrutiny, single non-transferable voting for several offices, proportional representation for certain committees and councils, and the handling of invalid ballots and tied results. The document is a detailed governance instrument: it combines hierarchical organisation with electoral procedures, defined rights of participation, and formal routes for resolving internal disputes.",
